```{python} 
# Using Python

import polars as pl
from lets_plot import *
LetsPlot.setup_html()

# Option 2: Read directly from GitHub and assign to an object

health = pl.read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-09-29/health.csv')
```


```{python}
df = (
    health
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("HL_FCL_HOS_2024")
        .str.replace_all(",", "")          # remove thousands separators
        .str.replace_all("%", "")          # remove percent signs if present
        .str.strip_chars()                 # trim whitespace
        .replace("NA", None)               # turn literal "NA" into null
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)    # now convert to number
    )
    .drop_nulls("HL_FCL_HOS_2024")
    .sort("HL_FCL_HOS_2024", descending=True)
    .head(10)
)

(
    ggplot(df, aes(x=as_discrete("GC_CNT_GAD_2025", order_by="HL_FCL_HOS_2024", order=-1),
                   y="HL_FCL_HOS_2024"))
    + geom_bar(stat="identity")
)

```
